exposure: presence or absence of abnormal fetal heart rate
grade III meconium stained amniotic fluid
presence or absence of thick amniotic fluid
outcome: admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 345 women who gave birth with grade III meconium stained amniotic fluid
finding: An observation time of greater than 4 hours after finding grade III meconium stained amniotic fluid might be possible in the first stage of labor if there is labor progression and no abnormal fetal heart rate.
